Overview

Mexico City is a city in Ciudad de México with a population of 9,209,944. The vibrant capital of Mexico with world-class museums, historic neighborhoods, and a thriving cultural scene. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher.
